items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow (same as prior injury), ruled OUT, X-rays negative for fracture; additional testing Monday. Expected to miss time (previously ~4 weeks/month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on freak play bracing fall after trip; carted off, towel over head.
items.implication: Significant absence likely; backup Marcus Mariota in; Commanders offense downgraded ROS short-term.

items.text: Raiders HC on TE Brock Bowers (knee): 'Close, very close. He looks great.' Was doubtful Week 2; potential Week 3 return.
Bears QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) being watched; walked under own power postgame, slight limp possible, tests Monday. Good spirits.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 3; not catastrophic appearance.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE; RJ Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now (preseason ignorees). Agrees Bernard stash (YAC/McCarthy fit) with Pittman out.
items.why: Status confirm + preseason advocacy for Coleman; Bernard YAC fit.
items.implication: Immediate waiver priority on backups; McConkey start.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE; played through injury with limited production (3 catches). Optimism and flak jacket noted pregame.
items.why: Rapid improvement, practiced limited Friday, pushing to play per Rapoport; no WR elevated.
items.implication: Startable if active but docked; decoy role possible, better Week 3 with heal time.
items.opportunity: Full role if healthy; primary target share.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) officially INACTIVE; not expected pregame.
items.implication: Opens backfield looks; stash/handcuff beneficiaries elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for backups like Jonah Coleman.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) officially ACTIVE and played.
items.why: Expected to play; elevated backup but confirmed active.
items.implication: Full offense online; Chase etc. boosted.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) ACTIVE; Levitan clean no docks.
items.implication: Start with confidence; no significant limitation expected.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time decision; won't practice consecutive days. Levitan notes GTD.
items.why: Hip (different from prior); no practice Sat.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; TE/other WR bumps if out.
items.opportunity: If out: elevated usage for backups.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet bullish tone. Puka true GTD, Olave clean/no docks, Harvey opens Coleman look, Pittman opens Bernard.
items.why: Practice/report tone and historical docks for ribs/hamstring/foot.
items.opportunity: Backup RB/WR volume spikes on absences.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT; Bateman expected for bigger role.
items.implication: Targets redistribute; Bateman primary beneficiary short-term.
items.opportunity: Elevated WR2/3 usage in Ravens offense.

items.text: Colts WR Michael Pittman (foot) OUT; expect look at Germie Bernard.
items.implication: Slot/YAC opportunities open for Bernard and others; McCarthy fit noted.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Colts WRs.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by HC Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Likely available soon; monitor but optimistic.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return in-game; on ETR watchlist.
items.implication: Monitor postgame status for Week 3; handcuff ready.
